# ORDO

> A measured, honest context-engineering framework for LLMs: a terse command grammar + an output-
> discipline contract + quality/autonomy gates. Runtime (decode/format/inbound) + a paste-in spec.
> No magic claims; an honest scorecard ships with it (GPT-tokenizer proxies; re-validate on your model).

## Start here
- [OPERATING-PROFILE.md](OPERATING-PROFILE.md): the whole framework on one page (paste into a system prompt).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an AI agent activates and uses ORDO.
- [README.md](README.md): install, the honest scorecard, runtime-vs-methodology.
- [ORDO.md](ORDO.md): the language skillstone (teach an LLM ORDO-G in one paste).

## Runtime (executable)
- src/index.js: decode(), emit()/bestFormat(), compressInbound() (measured-revert), ponytailFlags(), resolveModel(), classifyTask(), getSpec().
- tools/measure.mjs: real cost/token/duration meter from Claude Code's own JSONL usage.* (lossless billed counts).
- tools/clock.mjs: wall-clock latency harness (the path to EARN "faster"; cut until clock-ab.json records a paired win).
- tools/route_truth.py + trap_corpus.py + goal_lock_bench.py + judge.py + mcp_compact_ab.py: the foolproof A/B harnesses (charter §; docs/IMPROVEMENT-CHARTER.md).
- `npm install github:SprucetheAI/ordo` ; `npx github:SprucetheAI/ordo measure` ; `npx github:SprucetheAI/ordo init` (full) ; `npx github:SprucetheAI/ordo init --lean` ; `npm test`.
- THREE install tiers (docs/V2-ARCHITECTURE.md): ordo.md (paste-in) · ORDO Lean (`init --lean`, compaction only) · ORDO Full (`init`, + dispatcher + gates + bundled MCPs + .ordo/ persistence).

## Methodology (prompt SOPs — text, not code)
- spec/thinking.md (the single-pass dispatcher: classify LIGHT/STRICT → route effort; diction, verify-assert, goal-lock, reuse-replan, self-heal; divergence is a FLAG that escalates to the experimentalist gate, its generative half cut).
- spec/mcp-bundle.md (Full tier: bundle video/PDF/crawler MCPs, compact their output, measured −24–62%).
- spec/framework.md (REFEED loop + self-heal failure-branch), spec/experimentalist-gate.md, spec/evaluation-gate.md,
  spec/autonomy.md, spec/context-rot.md, spec/orchestration.md.
- spec/code-context.md (code-graph contract: AST-first, budgeted render, confidence-tagged edges).
- spec/decompose.md (task-graph data contract: lower-id DAG + per-node testStrategy).

## Continuity (v0.3, executable)
- hooks/ordo-continuity.mjs: one hook dispatched on event (UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, PreCompact, SessionStart(compact), PostCompact, SubagentStart). Logs the user's prompts verbatim, nudges anchor updates per context band, restores anchor + requests + git state after compaction. Replaces ordo-dispatch.
- docs/CONTINUITY.md: how the continuity layer works and what it guarantees.
- docs/OPUS-NOV-3.md: what the Opus Nov-3 release changes for ORDO and what stays necessary.
- tools/continuity_scan.py: scans real compactions and scores recall of the user's words (`python -I tools/continuity_scan.py --since 2026-10-01`).
- tools/continuity_replay.mjs: replays those compactions through the hook and re-scores (`node tools/continuity_replay.mjs`).

## Evidence
- BENCHMARKS.md (computed vs agent-judged, with reproduce commands).
- VERDICT.md (every measured number + the cut list).
- docs/SELF-EVAL.md (ORDO scored 7.6/10 by a fresh 5-rater blind pass — was 6.5 pre-V2; the per-dimension breakdown + the honest critique).
- DISCLAIMERS.md (private-use ethics; not for evading safety/monitoring).
